approach.summary: Forward raw webhook values through the injected Transformer exactly once, preserving result and error identity.
rules: Pass raw input unchanged; do not trim, uppercase, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values.
Call Started before Transform when observer is non-nil; call Finished only when Transform returns no error.
Return the original result and original error unchanged.

title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
